node.title: Re: Date::Calc on Windows
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Please use tags instead of 

 tags to format your code. That makes it easier for us to see that you're calling Time_to_Date([$time]), which is the mistake here: the square brackets in the [mod://Date::Calc] documentation in "($year,$month,$day, $hour,$min,$sec) = Time_to_Date([time])" refer to the fact that the time value is optional, not that you should put square brackets around the argument (which makes it an arrayref, which then gets interpreted by Time_to_Date as those strange datetimes you're getting).
